    giraffe_direction = giraffe.llm_query("Which direction is the giraffe looking?")

        giraffe_patches.sort(key=lambda p: abs(p.horizontal_center - giraffe.horizontal_center))

    elif "left" in giraffe_direction.lower():
        giraffe_patches.sort(key=lambda p: abs(p.horizontal_center - giraffe.horizontal_center))
        return giraffe_patches[0]
    else:
        return giraffe
